mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY increases above 2% without subsequent tightening.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strengthening demand, which boosts economic activity and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances following a sustained 3-month increase in HOUST.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which increases corporate costs and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE decreases below 5% without subsequent negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds the inflation rate (CPIAUCSL YoY), it signals a monetary tightening cycle, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or FEDFUNDS exceeds CPIAUCSL YoY without subsequent negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a supply shock, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO decreases by more than 1% MoM without subsequent negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 5% year-over-year signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or RSAFS increases by more than 5% YoY without subsequent positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or PAYEMS and UNRATE move in the specified direction without subsequent positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in GDP (GDPC1) signals a weakening economy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances following a sustained 3-month decline in GDPC1.
